reqs.name: Basin-wide collection
reqs.statement: The system shall support the collection of environmental monitoring data from sensor terminals located throughout the defined Congo River Basin service area.
reqs.threshold: 95% of designated deployment locations supported.
reqs.rationale: The system must provide geographically extensive data collection capabilities to support environmental monitoring throughout the basin.

reqs.name: Priority Data Delivery
reqs.statement: The system shall prioritize designated time-critical sensor messages over routine sensor messages when communication capacity is constrained.
reqs.threshold: Priority messages shall receive higher scheduling priority than routine messages.
reqs.rationale: Critical environmental conditions, such as rapid river level increases, may require immediate attention.

reqs.name: Low-Power Terminals
reqs.statement: The system shall support sensor terminals capable of operating for a minimum of five years without battery replacement under the defined operational duty cycle.
reqs.threshold: ≥5 years
reqs.rationale: Many sensors will be deployed in remote locations where maintenance and battery replacement are difficult.

reqs.name: Data Integrity
reqs.statement: The system shall detect corrupted sensor messages before delivering them to the designated data collection endpoint.
reqs.threshold: At least 99% detection of corrupted messages under defined test conditions.
reqs.rationale: Environmental monitoring data must be trustworthy, particularly when used to initiate emergency alerts.

reqs.name: Store-and-Forward
reqs.statement: The system shall retain sensor messages when an immediate satellite communication link is unavailable and transmit the stored messages when connectivity is restored.
reqs.threshold: Store at least 100 messages per sensor terminal.
reqs.rationale: Satellite coverage may be intermittent, especially with a limited LEO constellation.

reqs.name: Under-Canopy Connectivity
reqs.statement: The system shall support the collection of environmental monitoring data from sensor terminals deployed beneath forest canopy within the designated service area.
reqs.threshold: Successful message delivery from at least 90% of designated under-canopy test locations.
reqs.rationale: Dense vegetation can significantly attenuate radio-frequency signals, making communication difficult.

reqs.name: Sensor Network Capacity
reqs.statement: The system shall support simultaneous registration and scheduled data collection from at least 10,000 geographically distributed sensor terminals.
reqs.threshold: ≥10,000 registered terminals.
reqs.rationale: The network must accommodate large numbers of environmental sensors throughout the Congo River Basin.

reqs.name: Data Delivery
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver successfully received sensor messages to designated data collection endpoints.
reqs.threshold: ≥99% successful delivery of accepted messages within a defined reporting interval
reqs.rationale: Receiving sensor measurements at a satellite or relay is insufficient if the data never reaches the intended monitoring system.

reqs.name: Multi-Path Data Collection
reqs.statement: The system shall support sensor data collection through direct satellite communication and terrestrial relay communication paths.
reqs.threshold: Support at least two communication path types.
reqs.rationale: Multiple communication paths increase coverage and provide alternatives when direct satellite links are obstructed.

reqs.name: Alert transmission
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver emergency alerts to designated community receivers within 10 minutes of receiving an authorized alert transmission request under nominal operating conditions.
reqs.rationale: Establishes the alert transmission capability.

reqs.name: Geographic targeting
reqs.statement: The system shall support geographically targeted alert distribution to individually selected communities or groups of communities.
reqs.rationale: Ensures alerts reach the intended geographic areas.

reqs.name: Audible spoken alerts
reqs.statement: The system shall provide designated communities with the capability to receive and reproduce emergency alerts as audible spoken messages.
reqs.rationale: Establishes the need for community receivers and spoken alerts.

reqs.name: Reception confirmation
reqs.statement: The system shall provide confirmation of successful alert reception from each targeted community.
reqs.rationale: Establishes the delivery acknowledgment capability.

reqs.name: Independent of terrestrial networks
reqs.statement: The system shall support emergency alert delivery to designated communities without reliance on terrestrial communication networks.
reqs.rationale: Establishes independence from existing infrastructure.

reqs.name: Alert authorization
reqs.statement: The system shall prevent unauthorized users from initiating emergency alert broadcasts.
reqs.threshold: 100% rejection of unauthorized requests in a defined authentication test suite.
reqs.rationale: Prevents false emergency broadcasts and malicious use of the network.

reqs.name: Alert Prioritization
reqs.statement: The system shall prioritize emergency alert traffic over routine sensor data transmissions when communication capacity is constrained.
reqs.threshold: Emergency alerts assigned the highest network scheduling priority.
reqs.rationale: Emergency alerts should not be delayed by routine environmental monitoring.

reqs.name: Alert Language Support
reqs.statement: The system shall support the transmission and reproduction of emergency alerts in the designated languages of each participating community.
reqs.threshold: At least one designated language per community.
reqs.rationale: Emergency alerts must be understandable to their intended recipients.

reqs.name: Responder two-way comms
reqs.statement: The system shall provide two-way communications between responders and coordinating authorities.
reqs.rationale: Example: field coordination (MO-3).

reqs.name: Commands and acknowledgments
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver commands and acknowledgments to any responder terminal.
reqs.rationale: Example: closes the coordination loop (MO-3).

reqs.name: Survives terrestrial outages
reqs.statement: The system shall maintain responder communications without reliance on terrestrial networks.
reqs.rationale: Example: towers and grid fail in floods and conflict (MO-3).

reqs.name: Service area
reqs.statement: The system shall meet RFP requirement S3-01: Service area.
reqs.threshold: Entire 3.7M km² basin, including under 30-40 m canopy for sensors
reqs.rationale: Defines the geographical boundaries of the communications network.

reqs.name: Sensor Terminal Connectivity
reqs.statement: The system shall meet RFP requirement S3-02: Sensor terminals served / routine data per terminal per day.
reqs.rationale: Establishes the ability of sensor terminals to communicate with the network.

reqs.name: Airborne relay interface
reqs.statement: The system shall interface with airborne relay platforms for regional coverage during terrestrial outages.
reqs.rationale: Example: complementary A-1 relay; overlap TBR with the A-1 team.

reqs.statement: The system shall meet RFP requirement S3-05: Authorized alert to audible at a community receiver.
reqs.threshold: ≤10 min for ≥95% of receivers

reqs.statement: The system shall meet RFP requirement S3-06: Alert geo-targeting / spoken languages.
reqs.threshold: ≤50,000 km² / French + Lingala, Kiswahili, Kikongo, Tshiluba
reqs.rationale: RFP Level 0 requirement S3-06, values verbatim. Placement in this tree is proposed (TBR).

reqs.statement: The system shall meet RFP requirement S3-07: Community receiver.
reqs.threshold: ≤$25, solar or crank, fixed antenna with no pointing
reqs.rationale: RFP Level 0 requirement S3-07, values verbatim. Placement in this tree is proposed (TBR).

reqs.statement: The system shall meet RFP requirement S3-08: Responder two-way terminals.

reqs.name: Loudspeaker
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall reproduce received emergency alerts through an integrated loudspeaker.

reqs.name: Solar power
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall operate using electrical power supplied by solar panels.

reqs.name: Manual power
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall support manual electrical power generation through a hand crank.

reqs.name: Antenna transmission
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall receive satellite transmissions without requiring mechanical antenna pointing or tracking.

reqs.name: CAP ingest
reqs.statement: The ground segment shall validate and ingest CAP alerts issued by authorized national agencies.
reqs.rationale: Example: alert authority stays with national agencies (constraint).

reqs.name: Receiver plays alerts
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall play received alerts as audible speech.
reqs.rationale: Example: allocation of S3-05 and S3-07 to the receiver.

reqs.name: Broadcast relay
reqs.statement: The space segment shall relay geo-targeted alert broadcasts to community receivers.
reqs.rationale: Example: allocation of the broadcast leg to the space segment.

reqs.name: Launch to orbit
reqs.statement: The launch segment shall deliver the space segment to its operational orbit (orbit TBD by trade study).
reqs.rationale: Example: launch allocation; orbit not selected.

reqs.name: Receiver loudness
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall produce speech at a sound level of TBD dB at TBD m.
reqs.rationale: Example: placeholder value; set by analysis.

reqs.name: Receiver power
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall operate from solar or hand-crank power.
reqs.rationale: Example: derived from S3-07 (solar or crank).

reqs.name: Collect
reqs.statement: Collect short messages from thousands of low-power gauges, sensors, wildlife tags, and ranger devices anywhere in the basin, including under canopy.

reqs.name: Warn
reqs.statement: Broadcast geo-targeted, spoken alerts to every community and confirm delivery.

reqs.name: Coordinate
reqs.statement: Give rangers and responders two-way communications that survive loss of terrestrial networks.
